title: SDR-CIR: Semantic Debias Retrieval Framework for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating retrieval performance (using metrics like Recall@K and mAP@K) on standard zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) benchmarks (CIRR, CIRCO, FashionIQ). The paper specifically measures the mitigation of 'redundancy bias' (retaining irrelevant details from the reference image) and 'omission bias' (omitting key visual cues) by explicitly modeling and penalizing the reference image's visual semantic contribution during similarity computation.
